user_story: As a user, I want the system to reject a new password shorter than 8 characters during reset so that security standards are maintained.

positive.title: Password reset with valid new password
steps: Navigate to the password reset page.
Enter a new password of 8 characters (e.g., 'P@ssw0rd').
positive.expected_result: The password reset is successful, and the user is notified that their password has been changed.

negative.title: Password reset with invalid new password (shorter than 8 characters)
steps: Navigate to the password reset page.
Enter a new password of 7 characters (e.g., 'P@ssw0').
negative.expected_result: The system rejects the password and displays a message indicating that the password must be at least 8 characters long.

edge.title: Password reset with boundary condition (exactly 8 characters)
steps: Navigate to the password reset page.
Enter a new password that is exactly 8 characters long (e.g., 'A1b2C3d4').
edge.expected_result: The password reset is successful, and the user is notified that their password has been changed.
